title: Flat sheaf of modules on a ringed site
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site, $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$ and $\mathcal F$ a sheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Then $\mathcal F$ is *flat* if the functor $\Mod(\mathcal O)\to\Mod(\mathcal O)$, $\mathcal G\mapsto\mathcal G\otimes_{\mathcal O}\mathcal F$ (the tensor product of sheaves of modules [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]) is exact.

lean.note: Section 1(B), existing-interface repair without a new definition: retain the independent-universe IsFlatOnSite declaration for general ring sheaves and additionally expose its existing underlying CategoryTheory.exactFunctor predicate through this public-import module. IsFlatOnSite takes SheafOfModules and cannot take the Sheaf (ModuleCat Λ) encoding required by the recorded etale derived and constructible categories. In that encoding flatness is exactly exactFunctor applied to the canonical sheaf tensorRight L, the same defining condition as IsFlatOnSite; the new consumer uses that existing predicate directly. Neither flatness nor either sheaf tensor is redefined, no equivalence or comparison is assumed, and existing consumers of IsFlatOnSite are preserved.
